messages:
kai: FYI EU GPU pool-3 is ~95% for the last 6m, queue depth spiking. Clients are getting a lot of 429s. Autoscaler didn't kick because we hit region quota. Anyone seeing huge traffic from autocomplete/fastsearch?

marta: saw it too. Burst looks like a single customer (fastsearch-prod) + some internal e2e tests. Edge LB also returned a few 503s when backend worker queue overflowed.

jamie: are current 429s plain 429 or do we include any advisory headers right now? SDKs need something actionable.

kai: today it's plain 429 + Retry-After (seconds) from the ingress. Proposing we start emitting an advisory header with capacity hints instead of inventing new status codes. Draft header names: `X-RW-ADMIT-MS` (suggested admit window in ms), `X-RW-SUGGESTED-CONCURRENCY` (numeric), and `X-RW-RETRY-MS` (retry guidance in ms). Example header: `X-RW-ADMIT-MS: 50; X-RW-SUGGESTED-CONCURRENCY: 3; X-RW-RETRY-MS: 350`

ops-sre: +1 to advisory headers. two operational notes: 1) don't make values mandatory for old SDKs (opt-in via `X-RW-ADMIT-VERSION`). 2) include a `probed=true/false` flag when this 429 came from a capacity probe vs sustained saturation.

marta: SDK guidance proposal: on receiving 429 with admit headers SDK should (a) immediately reduce concurrency to suggested value, (b) apply randomized jittered backoff anchored on `X-RW-RETRY-MS`, (c) start a slow probe window after `X-RW-RETRY-MS` expires (probing 1 request every backoff cycle). Pseudocode we can paste into clients:

```\n// on 429 with headers\nconcurrency = min(concurrency, headers.suggested_concurrency)\nwait = headers.retry_ms * (0.8 + random() * 0.4)\nsleep(wait)\n// probe one request after sleep, if succeeds gradually ramp\n```

jamie: also propose per-region sticky token in response `X-RW-REGION-PREFERENCE: eu` so SDKs with multi-region routing can temporarily avoid EU and prefer us-east when SSE/TOS allow. Helps reduce tail saturation.

kai: on rollout: emit headers behind a feature-flag and set `X-RW-ADMIT-VERSION: 1` so we can iterate without breaking older SDKs. We'll initially enable for hosted-only traffic and opt-in Dedicated customers.

ops-sre: cost/operational tradeoff question: if we start aggressively routing away from EU, we'll increase cross-region egress and latency for EU users. Need to inform product/Sales for customer impact.

marta: agreed—add telemetry tag `admit_routed_away` in logs when we instruct clients to route. We'll count egress bytes and latency impact.

jamie: one more: for clients that can't route, suggest SDK implement a token-bucket local admit window and exponential decrease multiplier 0.6 on every 429, floor at 1 request. Add full-jitter when sleeping to avoid sync.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: `infra/admit-headers-v1` -> staging (CI passes).

oncall-bot: alert: EU pool queue depth returned to baseline at 1718501378, incident status: monitoring->OK.

kai: follow-up actions: 1) infra team to add header emit + `admit-version` flag. 2) SDKs to implement suggested behavior doc and opt-in switch. 3) Run canary with a small percentage of traffic for 24h and collect `admit_*` telemetry.

jamie: I'll draft SDK PR and a short runbook for oncall to toggle the flag.

marta: I'll add telemetry fields and a Grafana panel for `admit.suggested_concurrency` and `admit.routed_away`.

kai: thanks all :thumbsup: lets reconvene after canary data.
